title: beholdr-prism-mini routing config, version 1
description: beholdr-prism-mini routing config (project .beholdr/prism-mini.config.json or user ~/.beholdr/prism-mini.config.json). Never put API keys or tokens here.

$schema.description: Schema location for editor validation; written by prism.ts init.

version.description: Config format version. prism.ts migrate upgrades older files.

fast.description: Gathering: grep, file reads, codebase research, web fetches. Prefer cheap, quick models with reliable tool calls.

reasoning.description: Code, designs, and decisions; consumes briefs from fast workers.

roles.description: Candidates per role. In a project file, omit a role to inherit it from the user config; a listed role replaces the user's list.

brief_max_words.description: Word limit for each brief. Default 800.

total_brief_max_words.description: Word limit for all briefs in one gather, across workers. Default 2000.

worker_max_tool_calls.description: Tool-call budget for each fast worker. Default 15.

research.description: Overrides for web and documentation research, which needs more steps and longer briefs with sources. Defaults: 2000, 5000, 30.

brief_max_words.description: Word limit for each research brief. Default 2000.

total_brief_max_words.description: Word limit for all research briefs in one gather. Default 5000.

worker_max_tool_calls.description: Tool-call budget for each research worker. Default 30.

compression.description: Input compression: fast workers return condensed briefs to reasoning workers.

candidates.description: Candidates in preference order; the first runnable one is used.

model.description: Model identifier as the via harness names it.

via.description: Harness that runs the model: claude-code, codex, omp, or herdr:<kind>.

effort.description: Reasoning effort; omitted or unsupported values fall back to the harness default.

notes.description: Human context, such as cost or why the route is opt-in.
